<document id="savings-pockets">
HowˆSavingsˆPocketsˆworkˆSavingsˆPocketsˆareˆseparateˆbalancesˆinsideˆyourˆaccountˆthatˆearnˆinterest.ˆYouˆcanˆhaveˆupˆtoˆ10ˆofˆthem,ˆeachˆwithˆitsˆownˆnameˆandˆgoal.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆpocketˆTapˆSavings,ˆthenˆNewˆpocket.ˆNameˆit,ˆsetˆaˆgoalˆifˆyouˆlike,ˆandˆmoveˆmoneyˆin.ˆ##ˆMovingˆmoneyˆMovingˆmoneyˆbetweenˆyourˆmainˆbalanceˆandˆyourˆpocketsˆisˆinstantˆandˆfree,ˆeveryˆday.ˆThere'sˆnoˆlimitˆonˆhowˆmanyˆtimesˆyouˆcanˆwithdrawˆfromˆaˆpocket.ˆ##ˆInterestˆAllˆyourˆpocketsˆearnˆtheˆAPYˆforˆyourˆplan:ˆ0.50%ˆonˆBasic,ˆ2.00%ˆonˆPlusˆandˆ3.75%ˆonˆPremium.ˆRatesˆareˆvariable.ˆ##ˆSpendingˆfromˆaˆpocketˆYourˆcardˆspendsˆfromˆyourˆmainˆbalance,ˆnotˆfromˆpockets.ˆMoveˆmoneyˆbackˆfirst.ˆ##ˆClosingˆaˆpocketˆTapˆtheˆpocket,ˆthenˆClose.ˆAnyˆmoneyˆandˆaccruedˆinterestˆmoveˆtoˆyourˆmainˆbalance.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="card-virtual">
VirtualˆcardsˆEveryˆverifiedˆmemberˆcanˆcreateˆoneˆvirtualˆcardˆinˆtheˆapp.ˆItˆworksˆrightˆawayˆforˆonlineˆpurchasesˆandˆinˆmobileˆwallets,ˆsoˆyouˆcanˆkeepˆspendingˆwhileˆaˆphysicalˆcardˆisˆonˆitsˆway.ˆ##ˆCreateˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆTapˆCards,ˆthenˆAddˆvirtualˆcard.ˆTheˆcardˆnumber,ˆexpiryˆdateˆandˆsecurityˆcodeˆareˆshownˆinˆtheˆappˆafterˆyouˆconfirmˆit'sˆyou.ˆ##ˆHowˆit'sˆdifferentˆfromˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆcardˆnumber.ˆ-ˆItˆhasˆitsˆownˆfreezeˆswitch.ˆFreezingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆdoesn'tˆfreezeˆtheˆvirtualˆone.ˆ-ˆItˆcan'tˆbeˆusedˆatˆATMs.ˆ-ˆReportingˆyourˆphysicalˆcardˆlostˆorˆstolenˆdoesn'tˆcancelˆtheˆvirtualˆcard.ˆ##ˆReplacingˆaˆvirtualˆcardˆIfˆyouˆthinkˆtheˆvirtualˆcardˆnumberˆhasˆbeenˆexposed,ˆdeleteˆitˆinˆtheˆappˆandˆcreateˆaˆnewˆone.ˆThere'sˆnoˆfee.ˆRememberˆtoˆupdateˆanyˆmerchantsˆthatˆstoredˆtheˆoldˆnumber.ˆLimitsˆandˆfeesˆareˆtheˆsameˆasˆforˆyourˆphysicalˆcard,ˆandˆvirtualˆcardˆspendingˆcountsˆtowardˆtheˆsameˆdailyˆcardˆspendingˆlimit.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
<document id="disputes-duplicate">
ChargedˆtwiceˆforˆtheˆsameˆthingˆSeeingˆtheˆsameˆchargeˆtwiceˆdoesn'tˆalwaysˆmeanˆyouˆwereˆchargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆCheckˆifˆoneˆisˆpendingˆHotels,ˆgasˆstations,ˆcarˆrentalsˆandˆrestaurantsˆoftenˆplaceˆaˆtemporaryˆauthorization,ˆthenˆpostˆtheˆfinalˆamountˆseparately.ˆTheˆpendingˆoneˆusuallyˆdropsˆoffˆwithinˆ7ˆdays.ˆPendingˆtransactionsˆcan'tˆbeˆdisputed.ˆ##ˆIfˆbothˆhaveˆpostedˆIfˆtwoˆidenticalˆchargesˆhaveˆbothˆposted,ˆcontactˆtheˆmerchantˆfirst.ˆMostˆwillˆrefundˆaˆduplicateˆquickly.ˆIfˆtheˆmerchantˆdoesn'tˆhelp,ˆdisputeˆtheˆsecondˆchargeˆinˆtheˆappˆasˆaˆduplicate.ˆTapˆtheˆtransaction,ˆthenˆGetˆhelp,ˆthenˆChargedˆtwice.ˆ##ˆDuplicateˆfeesˆIfˆweˆchargedˆyouˆtheˆsameˆfeeˆtwice,ˆmessageˆsupport.ˆAˆfeeˆchargedˆinˆerrorˆisˆalwaysˆrefunded.ˆ##ˆTimeˆlimitˆDuplicateˆchargesˆfollowˆtheˆmerchantˆdisputeˆwindow:ˆ120ˆdaysˆfromˆtheˆtransactionˆdate.ˆ##ˆSplitˆpaymentsˆSomeˆmerchantsˆsplitˆoneˆorderˆintoˆseveralˆcharges,ˆforˆexampleˆwhenˆitemsˆshipˆseparately.ˆCheckˆyourˆorderˆconfirmationˆbeforeˆyouˆdispute.ˆNeedˆmoreˆhelp?ˆMessageˆusˆinˆtheˆappˆanyˆtime,ˆdayˆorˆnight.
</document>
</documents>
